abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the association between fetal hemodynamic changes seen in the presence of vascular tumors of fetal or placental origin and risk of adverse pregnancy outcome. METHODS: All cases of placental chorioangioma, sacrococcygeal teratoma and pulmonary sequestration during a 10-year period were included. Ultrasound data and pregnancy and long-term neurodevelopmental outcomes were assessed in this cohort. A survival analysis was performed to assess the relationship between the cardiovascular profile score (CVPS) and adverse pregnancy outcome. RESULTS: There were 56 fetal or placental tumors, including 28 chorioangiomas, 10 sacrococcygeal teratomas and 18 pulmonary sequestrations, diagnosed at a median gestation of 23 + 3 weeks. Abnormal CVPS (≤ 8) was seen in 30% of sacrococcygeal teratomas and in 46% of chorioangiomas, but in none of the pulmonary sequestration cases. Adverse pregnancy outcome occurred in 11 cases (three stillbirths, three neonatal deaths and five cases of developmental delay) and only in those cases in which the tumors were associated with a CVPS of ≤ 8. CONCLUSIONS: Certain fetal and placental vascular tumors are associated with cardiac dysfunction in fetal life. When the CVPS is low (≤ 8), these cases are at increased risk of both fetal/neonatal demise as well as overt long-term neurodevelopmental disability. The long-term neurodevelopmental outcome should be formally and prospectively assessed in cases of fetal and placental vascular tumors.
abstract_ja: 目的：胎児または胎盤由来の血管性腫瘍にみられる胎児血行動態の変化と、不良な妊娠転帰のリスクとの関連を評価する。方法：10年間に診断された胎盤性絨毛血管腫、仙尾部奇形腫、肺分画症のすべての症例を対象とした。このコホートについて超音波所見、妊娠経過、長期的な神経発達転帰を評価した。心血管プロファイルスコア(CVPS)と不良な妊娠転帰との関係を検討するために生存解析を行った。結果：胎児または胎盤の腫瘍は56例で、内訳は絨毛血管腫28例、仙尾部奇形腫10例、肺分画症18例であり、診断時の中央値は妊娠23週3日であった。CVPSの異常(≤8)は仙尾部奇形腫の30%、絨毛血管腫の46%にみられたが、肺分画症では認めなかった。不良な妊娠転帰は11例(死産3例、新生児死亡3例、発達遅滞5例)で発生し、いずれもCVPSが≤8の症例に限られていた。結論：特定の胎児および胎盤の血管性腫瘍は、胎児期の心機能障害と関連している。CVPSが低値(≤8)の症例では、胎児・新生児死亡および明らかな長期的神経発達障害のリスクが高まる。胎児および胎盤の血管性腫瘍の症例では、長期的な神経発達転帰を正式かつ前向きに評価すべきである。
